text:
Asking rents in Bielefeld stand at a median of 10.00 €/m² (2026-06), up 2.9% on the year and +24.6% over five years. That ranks Bielefeld #23 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 40% above the 2022 average contract rent of 7.12 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 600 € a month in cold rent, 13.3% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 30 days and 23% are gone within a week; with 1.7% market-active vacancy and +1.6% population growth over five years, the market looks broadly balanced.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 10.50 €/m² (+5.0%), with an 80% range of 10.24 to 10.75 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
